_comment: Category names are the top level of the screen menu, so these are the first French words anyone meets. Renault's internal vocabulary needs unpacking rather than translating literally: APV (après-vente) is after-sales, Usine is the factory/end-of-line context, Etudes is engineering, Flotte is fleet telematics, UCE (unité de commande électronique) is simply the ECU. Service codes like RDBLID or ReadDataByLID ($21) are left as-is — they name a UDS service and a technician recognises them.
